answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 46041 Country: India Title: Suunah of nail cutting Question: What is sunnah of nail cutting? What will be the sequence? Answer ID: 46041 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 938/733/H=1434) The hadiths which are narrated regarding the order of nail cutting are baseless. هكذا فى الفتاوى رد المحتار ص 260 ج 5 فى كتاب الحظر والاباحة (مطبوعه نعمانيه). Thus you may cut it as you wish, it shall be correct as per the Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
